observations.behavior: Adds a watcher re-keying step after repoints, keyed by teamId:distinctId, retaining highest version per distinct_id, and updating conversion_watchers with an idempotent UPDATE. P1.F6.H20: "Highest version wins per distinct_id: repoints are not Kafka-keyed, so a batch can carry a chain (anon -> A -> B) out of order, and re-keying onto an intermediate person would leave the watcher".
observations.posthog_connection: Re-keying watchers after repoints to avoid unreachable watchers; the UPDATE is idempotent and failure propagates to offset replay.

observations.behavior: Adds periodic refresh and sweep of conversion watchers, with unref'd timers to avoid event-loop leaks. P1.F6.H21: "Watchers that convert are deleted by the claim; ones that never convert are only removed here, so without this the table grows for the lifetime of the deployment."
observations.posthog_connection: Adds maintenance of conversion watchers; failure does not stop the matcher, degrading to flow-only behavior.
